rss.title: Merging Ice Beads in the Polar Night · Glass Chimes ASMR
rss.desc:
Tiny ice beads fall, touch and merge into snowy worlds. Follow three polar nights through 18 stages each: a hidden snow den, a quiet fjord waiting for the northern lights, and an emperor penguin keeping an egg warm.

53 minutes of soft glass taps, chimes and gentle winter scenes. No talking or music track, just the merge sounds and a quiet ambient pad. For studying, winding down or falling asleep.

00:00 Who sleeps in the snow?
16:46 Inside the polar bear den
17:01 Waiting for the northern lights
33:57 The northern lights arrive
34:12 Who hatches in the polar night?
51:08 The chick hatches
51:23 A quiet winter ending

🌈 More mesmerizing animations: @mellometry
#mellometry #asmr #satisfying #winter #relaxing #sleep #glasssounds

rss.title: Can It Reach the Christmas Star? 🎄
rss.desc:
One gold marble. Four drop heights. 140 glass Christmas ornaments between it and the star.

Every shattered bauble costs energy. How high does it need to fall to light all five points?

#shorts #mellometry #satisfying #physics #simulation #asmr #christmas

rss.title: Laser Marble Factory Fills A Christmas Tree · Relaxing ASMR
rss.desc:
64 glass marbles roll into a quiet workshop at night. Four machines split every marble again and again until 16,384 tiny beads fill a Christmas tree, one by one, all the way up to the star.

First a long laser sweeps through a glass ring, then each marble drops through a double laser curtain. A spiral laser cuts them again, and a steel jaw crusher squeezes the smallest ones until they burst. Every machine splits each marble exactly twice before it fits through the outlet. A bucket elevator carries the tiny beads up to the tree.

No music, no talking. Only the sounds of the machine: glass taps, soft laser cuts, rolling marbles and the gentle rain of beads in the tree. For sleeping, studying or winding down.

🌈 More mesmerizing animations: @mellometry
#mellometry #asmr #satisfying #christmas #relaxing #marbles #christmastree

rss.title: The Sound of Pi · Episode 1 (Digits 1–100)
rss.desc:
The first 100 digits of π, one glass marble each. Every digit has its own note, so π plays itself, digit by digit.

3.141592653589793238462643383279502884197169399375105820974944592307816406286208998628034825342117067

How often each digit appeared: 9 ×13 · 2, 3, 8 ×12 · 4 ×10 · 6 ×9 · 0, 1, 5, 7 ×8

Next episode: digits 101–200.

🌈 More mesmerizing animations: @mellometry

#shorts #mellometry #pi #thesoundofpi #satisfying

rss.title: How Deep Does the Star Go?
rss.desc:
A glowing ball bounces inside a ring and draws a star. In the middle of every star is a hole, and in that hole sits the next ring.

Zoom in, draw the next star, zoom in again. From 5 to 127 edges, every star faster and higher than the one before, until the picture is 126,913 times larger. Then the camera flies all the way back out, and you see all 13 stars nested inside each other.

🌈 More mesmerizing animations: @mellometry

#shorts #mellometry #simulation #satisfying #geometry #infinitezoom #maths #asmr

rss.title: This snail outruns light
rss.desc:
A snail starts at 1 mm/s and doubles its speed every second. At model second 39, it outruns light. Then it slows down and its rivals pass again.

Accelerated model time, staged rolling comparisons and changing camera scale. A mathematical animation. Real snails still obey relativity.

#shorts #mellometry #snail #math #satisfying #speedoflight

rss.title: A Chaos Pendulum Laser Splits Every Ball
rss.desc:
One ball, one glass ring and a laser that swings as a double pendulum. Every time the light touches a ball, that ball splits in two.

Some swings cut through the pile, some spin through empty space. The ring fills, cracks and finally bursts.

🌈 More mesmerizing animations: @mellometry

#shorts #mellometry #satisfying #physics #simulation #asmr #doublependulum #chaos

rss.title: One Marble vs One Million
rss.desc:
One gold marble multiplies by ten at every wall. One million blue marbles never grow, but they smash through seven walls in half a second.

Then both sides hit the same last wall: 62,000,000. Who gets through first?

🌈 More mesmerizing animations: @mellometry
#shorts #mellometry #satisfying #physics #maths #simulation #marbles

rss.title: Merging Ice Beads Until We Find Who's Sleeping 🐻‍❄️
rss.desc:
One tiny ice bead falls at a time. Two equal ones touch and become the next: a snowball, a frost ball, a pine cone, a hazelnut, rowan berries, a paw print in the snow.

Then the winter sleepers: a curled up hedgehog in the leaves, a fox with its tail over its nose, a snowy owl. And a snow hill with a little breath cloud. Who is sleeping inside? Polar bear cubs are born in the middle of winter, inside a snow den.

🌈 More mesmerizing animations: @mellometry
#shorts #mellometry #satisfying #winter #polarbear #simulation #oddlysatisfying #asmr

rss.title: A paper strip hides a dragon
rss.desc:
Fold a strip in half ten times, always the same way, and open every crease to a right angle. That is the dragon curve.

Four of them fit together without a single overlap. Fold once more and every dragon doubles: a copy swings around its tail and still nothing overlaps. Six more folds and 4,096 pieces become 262,144.

🌈 More mesmerizing animations: @mellometry

#shorts #mellometry #math #fractal #satisfying

rss.title: How long until one bacterium outweighs Earth?
rss.desc:
One bacterium weighs about a trillionth of a gram. Every 20 minutes it splits in two, and every new cell does the same. The colony rises up a tower of mass and passes a grain of salt, a drop of water, a coin, a glass, a bathtub, an elephant, a pool, the Great Pyramid, Loch Ness, all the oceans and the Moon.

After 44 hours and 133 divisions it is heavier than Earth. Six hours later it outweighs the Sun. Every object it passes rings one note higher, so you can hear it climb.

Real bacteria run out of food and space within hours. This is the maths of doubling, not biology.

🌈 More mesmerizing animations: @mellometry

#shorts #mellometry #math #bacteria #science #satisfying

rss.title: Math Functions on Harp: Easy to Weierstrass
rss.desc:
Seven mathematical curves played on harp. Each height maps to a fixed string, with no added melody or accompaniment.

The final level is an eight-term approximation of the Weierstrass function, a curve with detail at increasingly small scales.

🌈 More mesmerizing animations: @mellometry

#shorts #mellometry #math #harp #weierstrass

rss.title: Every Touch Rings the Glass
rss.desc:
Each light moves along a straight line. Together, 64 glowing marbles form a rolling circle, and every touch of the glass ring plays a note.

Then it spins faster and faster until the ring cracks and breaks.

🌈 More mesmerizing animations: @mellometry

#shorts #mellometry #satisfying #physics #math #asmr #glass

rss.title: Guess the Song Before the Star Closes
rss.desc:
A glowing ball bounces inside a ring and draws a star. Every time it hits the wall, it plays the next note of a famous tune.

Every new star has more edges, so the ball gets faster and the song gets faster too, from 7 edges up to 125. Each star starts the melody again, a little higher, and closes right on the end of a phrase. At which star did you know it?

🌈 More mesmerizing animations: @mellometry

#shorts #mellometry #simulation #satisfying #geometry #music #classicalmusic #asmr

rss.title: Merging Snow Globes Until The North Pole 🎅
rss.desc:
One tiny hailstone drops at a time. Two equal ones touch and become the next: a snowball, a frost bead, Christmas ornaments, a string of lights.

Then snow globes with a whole little world inside: a snowman, a tree with gifts, a Christmas market, a workshop. Every new stage hides behind a question mark until it appears.
